_about: Official links and tutorial videos shown on the FAFSA & TAP tab and used by the NextStep Assistant. Every URL was checked on last_verified (HTTP 200 after redirects). Video titles come from YouTube's oEmbed/watch-page metadata. Re-check with: python3 scripts/check_links.py

fafsa.verified_title: How to fill out the 2027-28 FAFSA Starting as a Student
fafsa.publisher_note: Published on YouTube by Get2College (a college-access nonprofit). Not produced by the U.S. Department of Education.
fafsa.embed_note: The video's owner has turned off playback on other websites (YouTube reports playableInEmbed=false and oEmbed returns 401), so NextStep shows a thumbnail that opens the video on YouTube instead of an embedded player.

tap.verified_title: NYS TAP Application: How to Complete It and Resolve Common Errors | HESC (FAFSA Ready Training)
tap.publisher_note: Published by the NYSStudentAid YouTube channel, which HESC's official website (hesc.ny.gov) links to as its YouTube channel. Published September 2025.

nys_grants.title: New York State grants and scholarships

tap_max_award.text: TAP awards range from $1,000 to $5,665 per year (HESC TAP page).

tap_deadline_2027_28.text: HESC lists the TAP application deadline for the 2027-28 academic year as 06/30/2028 (and 06/30/2027 for 2026-27). Apply as early as possible: colleges and other programs have earlier dates.

tap_income.text: HESC lists a net taxable income limit of $125,000 or less for dependent undergraduate students (lower limits apply to some independent students).

tap_residency.text: HESC says TAP students must be U.S. citizens or eligible noncitizens and legal New York State residents for 12 continuous months; non-residents, including undocumented students, should check the NYS DREAM Act.

tap_full_time.text: HESC says TAP students must attend an approved New York State college full time (12+ credits per semester) in a degree program and stay in good academic standing.

tap_through_fafsa.text: HESC's TAP page says to apply through the FAFSA, with a separate 'Apply for TAP' option if you did not apply through the FAFSA.
